_readme: Shown in page footers and on privacy and terms pages. operator_name / operator_location: the person or company that operates the site (shown in footer, terms and privacy notice; fill in before launch). calculation_author is the authorship label. Individual professional approval must be entered in tools/review_records.json only after a named qualified person has actually reviewed the calculator. tools/team_review_approval.json is an internal record only and is not shown on public pages. contact_email is where page feedback is sent.
